day_shape: 47 items: CENTCOM says its Iran blockade has redirected 53 vessels and disabled 2, Iran signals a near-deal with Oman on a temporary Hormuz route, Jerusalem Post reports Israel delaying Trump's Gaza plan, and Iran International logs ~100 artists summoned over anti-execution posts.

threads.label: Hormuz blockade and Oman shipping deal
threads.summary: CENTCOM said as of 8 August its blockade against Iran had redirected 53 commercial vessels, disabled 2 and boarded 2, with over 30 permitted through. Iran said it is 'very close' to a deal with Oman on a temporary Strait of Hormuz route but insisted the strait will not fully reopen until US conditions are met.

threads.label: Iran domestic crackdown and executions
threads.summary: Iran International reported nearly 100 artists and public figures summoned by security or judicial authorities after opposing a new wave of executions, including a public hanging in Isfahan. Separately, cleric Mohammad-Bagher Kharrazi was summoned to the Special Clerical Court, and an IRGC-affiliated singer was reported abducted and killed.

threads.label: Southern Lebanon incidents and Hezbollah
threads.summary: The IDF said a soldier was moderately wounded in an 'operational accident' in southern Lebanon and is expanding its investigation into a bomb blast that killed two soldiers last week, suspected to involve an old Israeli munition. Jerusalem Post reported a Hezbollah explosive drone near IDF troops by Beaufort Castle, and IRIB cited Al-Manar claiming Israeli forces set fires on heights in Deir al-Mizra, Kafr Houne, Niha and Ayn al-Tinah.

threads.label: Gaza plan and Israeli withdrawal review
threads.summary: Jerusalem Post reported Israel is delaying approval of Donald Trump's Gaza plan over concerns the next phase could constrain military action. IRIB, citing Israel's Channel 12, claimed Israeli security bodies are reviewing a withdrawal from parts of Gaza and handover to international forces, with a security official saying the US 'has not left many options for Israel'.

threads.label: Khamenei messaging and regime alignment
threads.summary: Khamenei's office posted that defence of Hezbollah Lebanon is Iran's 'strategic policy', in a response to a letter of allegiance from Hezbollah's secretary-general, and urged domestic media to refrain from 'addressing weaknesses'. Defa Press reported Iraqi Hezbollah's Akram al-Kaabi dismissing diplomacy with Riyadh and Badr Organisation's Hadi al-Amiri reviewing Popular Mobilisation Forces readiness in Baghdad.
